headerDisplay: Doimus plugin for TP-Link Tapo/Kasa devices. Supports Kasa/Tapo hubs (KH100/H100) with sensors, Tapo WiFi cameras, and doorbells.
footerDisplay: For hub devices: configure your Tapo/Kasa account email, password, and hub IP addresses. For cameras: configure each camera's IP, Tapo credentials, and RTSP stream credentials.

email.title: Tapo/Kasa Account Email
email.description: Your TP-Link Tapo/Kasa account email. Also used for cloud camera discovery and P2P media streaming.

devices.title: Hub IP Addresses
devices.description: IP addresses of your Kasa/Tapo hubs (KH100/H100)

pollInterval.title: Polling Interval (seconds)
pollInterval.description: How often to poll hub devices for state updates

discoverCameras.title: Auto-discover cameras
discoverCameras.description: List cameras from your Tapo cloud account and register the ones found on the LAN. Uses hubs.email/password for the cloud login.

discoveryTimeout.title: LAN Discovery Timeout (ms)
discoveryTimeout.description: How long to probe the LAN for Tapo devices (TDP discovery)

subnet.title: LAN Subnet (CIDR)
subnet.description: Your camera LAN subnet, e.g. "192.168.1.0/24". Unicast-probes every host so discovery works even when the host can't receive UDP broadcasts (Docker/containers). Auto-detected on Linux with host networking; set it explicitly if cameras don't appear.

discoveryInterval.title: Re-discovery Interval (ms)
discoveryInterval.description: How often to re-scan the LAN for cameras (sleeping battery cameras get retried). 0 disables periodic re-discovery.

cameras.title: Tapo WiFi Cameras
cameras.description: Configure your Tapo WiFi cameras and doorbells

ipAddress.title: Camera IP Address
ipAddress.description: IP address of the Tapo camera

password.title: Tapo Account Password
password.description: Your Tapo account password (or camera password if different)

streamUser.title: RTSP Username
streamUser.description: RTSP stream username (from Tapo app > Camera Account). Only needed for RTSP streaming (mains cameras).

streamPassword.title: RTSP Password
streamPassword.description: RTSP stream password (from Tapo app > Camera Account). Only needed for RTSP streaming (mains cameras).

streamMode.title: Stream Mode
streamMode.description: auto = use RTSP when RTSP credentials are set (or for battery cameras use P2P), rtsp = force RTSP, p2p = use the proprietary TP-Link media protocol (TCP/8800). Battery/doorbell cameras have no RTSP and always use P2P.

streamQuality.title: P2P Stream Quality
streamQuality.description: Resolution requested from the camera over the P2P media protocol.

deviceId.title: Device ID (hub children)
deviceId.description: Tapo deviceId for cameras streamed through a hub. Usually set automatically by cloud discovery.

batteryPowered.title: Battery-Powered
batteryPowered.description: Enable if this is a battery-powered camera (C420, C425, D230, etc.). Adds battery level reporting.

disableBatteryReporting.title: Disable Battery Reporting
disableBatteryReporting.description: Skip battery status queries for this camera

pullInterval.title: Pull Interval (ms)
pullInterval.description: Polling interval for camera status updates

snapshotOnMotion.title: Snapshot on Motion
snapshotOnMotion.description: Capture MJPEG snapshots only when ONVIF motion is detected (recommended for battery cameras). When disabled, snapshots are taken on every poll interval.

snapshotCooldown.title: Snapshot Cooldown (ms)
snapshotCooldown.description: Minimum time between motion-triggered snapshots (prevents rapid-fire captures)
